name: Spa-Francorchamps
coordinateSystem: x east, y north, z altitude; metres; local equirectangular projection

grid.note: Start line uses GeoJSON origin aligned approximately with the official map; pole is on driving-right (FIA circuit list); grid offset, spacing and markings are illustrative, not certified 2026 grid measurements.

quality.layout: public-reconstruction: MIT community GeoJSON; centripetal interpolation
quality.elevation: official map anchors; local Raidillon profile from registered OpenF1 relative heights
quality.width: estimated profile in published ELMS 11–14 m range; grid widening and local 12 m Bruxelles width are engineering estimates
quality.curbs: estimated placement and dimensions on selected corner ranges
quality.friction: assumed constant 1.6; no physics simulation yet

sources.title: FIA licensed circuits list, Spa pole RIGHT and reference width 10 m
sources.use: pole side and reference width only; not a current full road survey
